```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(rvest)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

base = "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Dancing_with_the_Stars_(American_TV_series)_season_"
seasons = 1:35

cast_pages = vector("list", length(seasons))
week_pages = vector("list", length(seasons))

for (i in seq_along(seasons)) {
  
  season_url = paste0(base, seasons[i])
  pg = rvest::read_html(season_url)
  
  all_tables = pg |> rvest::html_table(fill = TRUE)
  all_tables = lapply(all_tables, function(t) {
    names(t) = make.names(names(t), unique = TRUE)
    return(t)
  })
  
  # 1. Casts Table: keep only Celebrity, Notability, Status, and season
  cast_idx = which(sapply(all_tables, function(t) "Celebrity" %in% names(t) && "Notability" %in% names(t)))[1]
  if (!is.na(cast_idx)) {
    cast_pages[[i]] = all_tables[[cast_idx]] |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        season = seasons[i],
        dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), as.character)
      ) |>
      dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c("Celebrity", "Notability", "Status", "season")))
  }
  
  # 2. Weekly Table: match any table with Couple and Dance
  week_idx = which(sapply(all_tables, function(t) "Couple" %in% names(t) && "Dance" %in% names(t)))
  
  if (length(week_idx) > 0) {
    season_weeks = vector("list", length(week_idx))
    for (w in seq_along(week_idx)) {
      
      tbl = all_tables[[week_idx[w]]] |>
        dplyr::mutate(
          season = seasons[i],
          week_table_num = w,
          dplyr::across(dplyr::everything(), as.character)
        )
      
      # Standardize score column name (handles "Score", "Scores", or "Judge.s.scores")
      score_col = names(tbl)[stringr::str_detect(names(tbl), stringr::regex("score", ignore_case = TRUE))][1]
      if (!is.na(score_col) && score_col != "Scores") {
        names(tbl)[names(tbl) == score_col] = "Scores"
      }
      
      # Only process if a valid Scores column exists in this table
      if ("Scores" %in% names(tbl)) {
        season_weeks[[w]] = tbl |>
          dplyr::select(dplyr::any_of(c("Couple", "Scores", "Dance", "Result", "season", "week_table_num"))) |>
          dplyr::filter(
            !is.na(Scores),
            stringr::str_trim(Scores) != "",
            # Catches "No scores received", "No scoresreceived", "No score received", or "N/A" in any column
            !stringr::str_detect(Couple, stringr::regex("no\\s*scores?\\s*received", ignore_case = TRUE)),
            !stringr::str_detect(Scores, stringr::regex("no\\s*scores?\\s*received|n/a", ignore_case = TRUE))
          )
      }
    }
    week_pages[[i]] = dplyr::bind_rows(season_weeks)
  }
  
  Sys.sleep(1)
}

dwts_casts  = dplyr::bind_rows(cast_pages)
dwts_weekly = dplyr::bind_rows(week_pages)

# Create a local "data" folder if it doesn't exist yet
if (!dir.exists("data")) {
  dir.create("data")
}

# Save both datasets to CSV
readr::write_csv(dwts_casts, "data/dwts_casts.csv")
readr::write_csv(dwts_weekly, "data/dwts_weekly.csv")
```
